hook_suggestion: ch23 拼层时每个注意力积木长得都一样：qkv_proj 一把投出 Q/K/V、o_proj 收尾，五行完事。可形状账里早埋着问题——Llama-3-70B 有 64 个 query 头却只配 8 份 K/V（q_size 是 kv_size 的 8 倍），这不是疏忽是省钱设计；DeepSeek-V3 更极端：128 个头的注意力，每个 token 每层要缓存的不是 2×128×128=32768 个元素，而是 576 个——而且 KV cache 里装的甚至不是 K 和 V，是一个 512 维『潜向量』加一根 64 维所有头共享的 key，谁也没法直接拿它们去算 softmax(qᵀk)。128 个头凭什么共用一份 576 维缓存还够用、性能还不掉？这个 512+64 从哪来、被压掉的 K/V 上投影去哪了、每个 token 都要的位置编码 RoPE 又塞在哪？
one_line: 注意力变体是一条『KV cache 每 token 要付多少元素』的账：MHA 每 token 每层缓存 2·n_h·d_h 个元素（K、V 各 n_h 份逐头向量，解码每步全量读——带宽与容量双卡）；MQA 把 H 个 KV 头砍到 1（cache/带宽降 H 倍，容量也降）；GQA-g 在两者间插值——query 头分 G 组、每组共享一份 K/V（GQA-1=MQA、GQA-H=MHA）。MLA 换路：不砍头、改降维——W^DKV 把 K/V 联合压进 d_c 维潜向量 c^KV（每 token 只缓存它），W^UK/W_UV 用时上投影逐头恢复；且由矩阵乘法结合律，W^UK 可吸进 W^UQ、W^UV 可吸进 W^O（纯参数侧、离线一次），连 K/V 都不必物化；RoPE 矩阵位置敏感、夹在中间破坏吸收（无交换律），故把位置信息解耦成所有头共享的 k^R（d_h^R 维）单独缓存——总账 (d_c+d_h^R)=512+64=576 元素/token/层，等效仅 2.25 组的 GQA，性能反强于 MHA（App D.2）。vLLM 落地四件：GQA=QKVParallelLinear 的 total_num_kv_heads 头数账；MLA=DeepseekV2MLAAttention 的fused_qkv_a_proj/q_b_proj/kv_b_proj 投影骨架 + mla.py 标准 forward + MLAAttention 的 num_kv_heads=1/head_size=576 缓存规格。

stations.what: 【基线·代码形状账】ch23 站 9 拼过的积木翻过来看内部：total_num_heads 与 total_num_kv_heads 两套头数（L141-L153，TP 下 KV 头『多于 tp 切分/少于 tp 复制』）、q_size=num_heads×head_dim 与 kv_size=num_kv_heads×head_dim（L157-L158）——MHA 时两数相等；qkv_proj 一把投出 Q/K/V（L162-L170）。本章全部变体都发生在这两行头数账上。
【基线·数学】标准 MHA 全式：h_t 三投影（式1-3）→ 切 n_h 头（式4-6）→ 逐头 softmax(qᵀk/√d_h)·v（式7）→ W^O 拼回（式8）；尾句立靶子——MHA 推理需缓存 2·n_h·d_h·l 个元素/token，『限制最大 batch 与序列长度的瓶颈』。
【谱系·分组插值】MHA(H 个 KV 头)→MQA(1 个)→GQA-g(每组共享 1 个)：GQA-1=MQA、GQA-H=MHA；MHA→MQA 把 KV cache 与加载量砍 H 倍（§2.2 原话），但大模型头数随规模涨、MQA 对带宽与容量都是更激进的砍法——GQA 保持同比缩减。Fig.2 三架构对照图（key_figures 已登记）。

【谱系·落地】QKVParallelLinear：docstring 自述『KV 头少于 query 头（multi-query/grouped-query）时 KV 头复制、query 头切分』（L1028-L1030）；total_num_kv_heads=None 默认等于 total_num_heads（MHA）；num_kv_head_replicas=tp_size/total_num_kv_heads（L1074-L1081）——GQA 的『分组』在权重层就是一个除法，output_sizes 三段里 k/v 两段按 num_kv_heads 计（L1083-L1088）。
【压缩·数学】低秩联合压缩：c^KV=W^DKV·h_t 压进 d_c 维（式9）、k^C/v^C 由 W^UK/W^UV 上投影恢复（式10-11）；推理只缓存 c^KV（d_c·l 个元素）；关键论断——W^UK 可吸进 W^Q、W^UV 可吸进 W^O，『甚至不必把 K/V 算出来』。query 侧同构低秩（式12-13，d_c'，压训练激活不压 cache）。

【解耦 RoPE·数学】RoPE 与低秩压缩不相容的论证：RoPE 矩阵位置敏感、若作用于 k^C 则当前 token 的 RoPE 矩阵落在 W^Q 与 W^UK 之间、乘法无交换律→吸收失效→逐 token 为全前缀重算 keys。解法：所有头共享 k^R=RoPE(W^KR·h_t)（式15，单份不逐头）+ 逐头 q^R（式14）；q/k 拼接 [C;R]（式16-17）、分母 √(d_h+d_h^R)（式18）；k^R 也要缓存——总账 (d_c+d_h^R)。

【总账】四种机制每 token 元素数：MHA 2n_h·d_h·l / MQA 2d_h·l / GQA 2n_g·d_h·l / MLA (d_c+d_h^R)·l（按元素、不分精度）；DeepSeek-V2 取 d_c=4d_h、d_h^R=d_h/2 → MLA=GQA 仅 2.25 组；超参 n_h=128/d_h=128/d_c=512/d_c'=1536/d_h^R=64——576=512+64 的出处；潜向量后 RMSNorm+瓶颈 scale 的训练稳定注记也在此节。

【落地·投影骨架】DeepseekV2MLAAttention.__init__ 把论文矩阵落成模块名：fused_qkv_a_proj 输出 [q_lora_rank, kv_lora_rank+qk_rope_head_dim]（W^DQ 与 W^DKV+W^KR 融合一条 GEMM）；q_lora_rank=None 时退化 kv_a_proj_with_mqa+q_proj——DeepSeek-V2-Lite 不压 query（App B.1）的代码对应；q_a_layernorm→q_b_proj（式12-13+式14 的 W^QR 都从 q_c 出）；kv_a_layernorm；kv_b_proj：kv_lora_rank→num_heads×(qk_nope+v)（=[W^UK;W^UV] 按头拼接）；o_proj（W^O）。

【落地·标准前向】MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper.forward：fused_qkv_a_proj→split(q_c|kv_lora)→q_a_layernorm→q_b_proj 升回 full q→split(kv_c|k_pe)→kv_a_layernorm→k_pe.unsqueeze(1)（共享 key 广播给所有头）→RoPE 只旋 q 的 rope 段与 k_pe（L200-L203）→mla_attn 插座→o_proj。论文式(9)-(19) 与代码逐行对得上的最干净现场；indexer 分支（L205-L206）留 ch26。

【落地·矩阵账本】header 数学文档：维度记号 Lq=1536/Lkv=512/P=128/R=64/V=128（DSV3 值就地注释）+ 八矩阵 W_DQ/W_UQ/W_QR/W_DKV/W_UK/W_KR/W_UV/W_O 形状账（L56-L63）——论文记号↔vLLM 记号的官方对照表（kv_b_proj=[W_UK;W^UV]、q_b_proj=[W_UQ;W_QR]、out_proj=W_O，L88-L91 紧随其后）；q_pe 逐头而 k_pe 单份——解耦 RoPE 的形状级表达。其后的两条路径伪代码（L66-L118）是 ch25 的入口。

【落地·缓存规格】MLAAttention：head_size=kv_lora_rank+qk_rope_head_dim（L393，DSV3 即 576——每 token 写进 KV cache 的宽度）、num_kv_heads=1（L397，128 个头对缓存层只报 1 个 KV 头）；get_kv_cache_spec 报 MLAAttentionSpec(num_kv_heads=1)；页字节公式对照：普通层 2×block×num_kv_heads×head_dim×dtype vs MLA 层去 2 因子单份潜向量——Table 1 在引擎账本（ch14 显存账）的接入点。
【收束·全公式与代际沿用】附录 C 按计算序重排全公式、蓝框单独标出仅有的两个需缓存向量（式41：c^KV、k^R），尾段两句（naive 展开/离线吸收）是 ch25 双路的论文依据；V3 §2.1.1 重述把蓝框直接写进式 V3-1/V3-3，超参与 V2 一字未改——576 口径跨代稳定，不是 V2 的一次性配置。

why_chains.decision: MLA 三代演化：KV cache 只存压缩潜向量；prefill/decode 两种相反的展开策略（MHA 展开 vs MQA 吸收）；DSV4 再上上下文压缩+fp8_ds_mla 自定义布局
why_chains.old_design: MHA/GQA：每 token 缓存 K、V 各 num_kv_heads×head_dim。DSV3 若 128 头 MHA，每 token 每 layer 需 128×(192+128)=40960 元素；Llama-70B GQA（8 KV 头×128 维）也要 2048。KV cache 总量是长上下文并发的第一瓶颈——PagedAttention（分页）只解决碎片与共享，不降低每 token 总量。
why_chains.pain: 长上下文批量并发的显存天花板：KV cache 装不下 → 要么砍 batch 要么砍上下文。DSV2 论文（arXiv:2405.04434，mla_attention.py:L28-L29 引用）把 KV 低秩压缩进潜空间。
why_chains.solution: DSV2/V3 世代（vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py）：cache 只存 kv_lora_rank(512)+qk_rope_head_dim(64)=576 元素/token/layer（header 数学文档 L17-L100：Sq/Skv 比值决定路径、W_DQ/W_UQ/W_DKV/W_UK/W_UV 矩阵账本 L45-L70）；prefill（Sq/Skv≈1）compute-friendly MHA 路径——kv_b_proj 把潜向量上投影成完整 K/V 再标准 attention（forward_mha 调用点 L820-L838）；decode（Sq/Skv 小）data-movement-friendly MQA 路径——q 侧先乘吸收权重进潜空间、576 维当 MQA 做、输出再上投影（forward L601 内 num_mha_tokens/num_mqa_tokens 分流 L770-L770+，吸收 bmm L860+——同一前向内 prefill/decode token 混批分流，比 v0.21 的两条独立 forward 更优雅）；过程权重存重排副本 W_UK/W_UV（process_weights_after_loading L994-L1040，split 在 L1033）；get_mla_dims 兼容统一 head_dim 与分离字段两种记法（L1501+）。DSV4 第三代（vllm/models/deepseek_v4/attention.py）：统一 head_dim=512 语义、fp8_ds_mla UE8M0 块缩放 uint8 布局 584B/token（448 NoPE+128 RoPE+8 scale，vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:L409-L413）、compress_ratio=4 上下文压缩（仅 C4A 层带 indexer 选 top-k，attention.py:L207-L213、L277-L297）、输出侧 o_lora_rank/o_groups 低秩（L200-L262）、alignment 576B 页对齐（L663-L674）；DSV3.2 稀疏 MLA 656B 布局（kv_cache_interface.py:L414-L416）；IndexCache 缓存 indexer 打分结果跨轮复用（attention.py:L677+ DeepseekV4IndexerCache）。
why_chains.cost: ① prefill 上投影要物化 [Skv, N, P+V] 大张量 → chunked prefill workspace 分块 + LSE merge（determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size，mla_attention.py:L590-L600；git df71917cf 'Optimize workspace reuse for eager break, 3.9% E2E TTFT improvement' 实证这块代价真实存在且有专人优化，vllm/models/deepseek_v4/eager_scratch.py 即其产物）；② 同层两条数值路径，正确性靠 merge_attn_states 对齐；③ 特形 KV 与所有通用后端不兼容 → MLA 需要独立 backend 家族（MLAAttentionSpec 的 cache_dtype_str/alignment/compress_ratio 字段就是给 KV 账本分组的）；④ 记法漂移的税由框架侧吃（get_mla_dims 双格式兼容）；⑤ compress_ratio>1 的层读写都要经过压缩器（DeepseekCompressor），cache 命中/共享语义与普通层不同。

theory.topic: KV cache 的元素账：它同时卡住带宽与容量
theory.content: 自回归解码每步要把全部历史 K/V 读一遍（带宽）且全程驻留（容量）——GQA 论文开篇即把『loading decoder weights and all attention keys and values at every decoding step』的 memory bandwidth overhead 列为解码瓶颈（§1）。账式：每 token 每层 2·n_kv_heads·head_dim 个元素（K 一份、V 一份、逐头）。感受数字（计算例，非论文原文）：Llama-2-7B FP16 每 token KV ≈ 2×32 层×32 头×128 维×2B ≈ 0.5MB（引 deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[1]）；按论文超参（n_h=128、d_h=128）MHA 每 token 每层 2·128·128=32768 元素，MLA 为 576——约 1.75%。口径警示（三个数不可混用）：V2 abstract『reduces the KV cache by 93.3%』是相对 DeepSeek 67B（不同头配置）的口径；1.75% 是按 Table 1 公式+§3.1.2 超参的算术；App D.2 的 14%/4% 是 MoE 模型整体实测口径。

theory.topic: MHA 基线：式(1)-(8) 的形状账
theory.content: h_t∈R^d 经 W^Q/W^K/W^V∈R^{d_h·n_h×d} 三投影（式1-3），q_t/k_t/v_t 切成 n_h 个 d_h 维头（式4-6），逐头 o_{t,i}=Σ_j softmax_j(q_{t,i}ᵀk_{j,i}/√d_h)·v_{j,i}（式7），W^O 拼回（式8）。vLLM 落点形状同构：qkv_proj 输出 q_size+2·kv_size、forward 里 split 后 q view 成 (T, num_heads, head_dim)——ch20 站 6 的 varlen kernel 吃的就是这个形状；式7 的 √d_h 缩放即 llama.py 的 self.scaling=head_dim**-0.5。

theory.topic: 分组谱系：头数轴上的插值
theory.content: MQA（Shazeer 2019，经 GQA 论文谱系引用）：只留 1 个 KV 头——cache 与带宽降 H 倍，但容量同步被砍（『a more aggressive cut in both memory bandwidth and capacity』）。GQA-g：query 头分 G 组、每组共享一份 K/V；GQA-1=MQA、GQA-H=MHA——『中间组数 = 比 MQA 质量高、比 MHA 快』的插值。工程配套：uptraining——K/V 投影 mean-pool 成目标头数（优于选单头/随机初始化）+ 原配方预训练 α 比例步数（主实验 α=0.05，约 600 TPUv3 chip-days）；组数取舍（Fig.6）：1→8 组只温和变慢、靠近 MHA 代价递增，作者选 8——LLaMA-2/3 的 8 KV 头出处。vLLM 落点：QKVParallelLinear 的 total_num_kv_heads 参数即 G——MHA/GQA/MQA 在代码里只是这一个整数。

theory.topic: 低秩联合压缩：c^KV 作为 K/V 的共享潜空间
theory.content: 式(9)-(11)：W^DKV∈R^{d_c×d} 把 h_t 压进 c^KV∈R^{d_c}（d_c≪d_h·n_h），k^C=W^UK·c^KV、v^C=W^UV·c^KV（W^UK/W^UV∈R^{d_h·n_h×d_c}）逐头恢复；推理只缓存 c^KV→d_c·l 元素。要点：k^C/v^C 是全 n_h 头拼接的上投影——『每个头看同一个潜向量的不同投影』，与 GQA『每组头看同一份 K/V』的共享方式本质不同（GQA 复制的是现成向量、MLA 共享的是生成基底）。query 侧式(12)-(13)同构（c^Q∈R^{d_c'}、W^UQ 上投影）——压训练激活内存，不压 cache；DeepSeek-V2-Lite 干脆不压（App B.1），代码留了 q_lora_rank=None 退化分支。

theory.topic: 吸收恒等式：结合律让 K/V 不必物化
theory.content: 注意力分数 q_{t,i}ᵀ·k^C_{j,i} = q_{t,i}ᵀ(W^UK_i·c^KV_j) = ((W^UK_i)ᵀq_{t,i})ᵀ·c^KV_j——把 W^UK 预乘进 query 侧（V2 正文记号说吸进 W^Q；带 query 压缩的精确口径是吸进 W^UQ，附录 C——写作统一用附录 C 口径）；同理 W^UV 吸进 W^O。纯参数侧变换、离线一次完成；推理时 c^KV 直接当『单头 K/V』参与 attention（MQA 形状）。naive 形态（用时上投影展开回 MHA 形状）与吸收形态的取舍（Sq/Skv 比值、物化代价）是 ch25 主题；本章只需确信两者由结合律数学等价。数值口径提醒：absorb 后分数对 √(d_h+d_h^R) 的缩放不受影响（缩放是标量乘、与吸收次序交换）。

theory.topic: RoPE 与吸收的冲突：非交换性论证
theory.content: 若对 k^C 施加 RoPE：分数= qᵀ·R(pos)ᵀ·(W^UK)ᵀ·q 型——当前生成 token 的 RoPE 矩阵 R 落在 query 权重与 W^UK 之间；R 逐位置不同且矩阵乘法无交换律，(W^UK)ᵀ·R(pos) 无法离线合并 → 吸收失效 → 每 token 要为全部前缀重算 keys（论文 §2.1.3 原论证）。解法=解耦：位置信息走旁路——k^R=RoPE(W^KR·h_t)∈R^{d_h^R} 所有头共享单份（不逐头、不压入潜向量），q 侧逐头 q^R=RoPE(W^QR·c^Q)（式14-15）；q_i=[q^C_i;q^R_i]、k_i=[k^C_i;k^R]（式16-17）；分数分母改 √(d_h+d_h^R)=√192（式18，代码 qk_head_dim**-0.5）。结构性后果：YaRN 上下文扩展只作用于 k^R（§3.1.4 原句『as it is responsible for carrying RoPE』）；k^R 是唯一额外缓存项——总账从 d_c 变 (d_c+d_h^R)。

theory.topic: 总账 Table 1 与 2.25 组换算
theory.content: 每 token 每 l 层的元素数：MHA 2·n_h·d_h·l / MQA 2·d_h·l / GQA 2·n_g·d_h·l / MLA (d_c+d_h^R)·l（按元素、不分精度）。DeepSeek-V2/V3 取 d_c=4·d_h、d_h^R=d_h/2 → (d_c+d_h^R)/(2·d_h)=(4d_h+d_h/2)/(2d_h)=2.25——MLA 的 cache 等效 GQA-2.25，而 App D.2 显示性能反强于 MHA（MoE 对齐实验，cache 为 MHA 的 14%/4%）。对照面：App D.1（7B dense、对齐参数量）MHA 显著优于 GQA/MQA——分组路线确有质量代价，MLA 是『不砍头、改降维』绕开这个代价的另一条路。注：Table 1 表体为包内重建（抓取丢失、由 caption+prose 直推），引用时保留该标注。

theory.topic: 跨代不变性：V3 重述、超参一字未改
theory.content: V3 §2.1.1 把 MLA 压缩为一节重述：数学与 V2 完全一致（式 V3-1..V3-11 对应式9-19 的重排），并把『需缓存 c^KV 与 k^R』直接蓝框进式 V3-1/V3-3——比 V2 原文更醒目的『KV cache 装的是什么』口径。超参 n_h=128/d_h=128/d_c=512/d_c'=1536/d_h^R=64 与 V2 相同（§4.2）——576 口径跨代稳定，不是 V2 的一次性配置；V3 报告显式声明的架构变化都在 MoE 侧。V4（本书 pin 世代）的 MLA 结构演化（统一 head_dim=512、fp8_ds_mla 584B/token、compress_ratio 上下文压缩、o_lora/o_groups 输出低秩）不在本论文包内——以源码为准，留 ch25 末节/ch28 capstone 讲。

mechanisms.name: KV 显存账：每 token 每层缓存什么、付多少
mechanisms.note: 读者认知起点：把『注意力变体』重构为『KV cache 每 token 元素账』的变体。代码形态：AttentionSpec.real_page_size_bytes 的 2×block_size×num_kv_heads×head_dim×dtype_bytes——2=K/V 各一份、num_kv_heads=头数。worked example 素材：Llama-2-7B ≈0.5MB/token（引 memory-kv 卡）+ 按论文超参的 MHA 32768 vs MLA 576（1.75%）；三个 cache 口径（93.3%/1.75%/14%-4%）的区分表。前接 ch13/ch14（分页与账本：分页只解决碎片、不降总量——本章付总量的账）。

mechanisms.name: MHA 基线：式(1)-(8) 与 vLLM 的 q/k/v split 同构
mechanisms.note: 投影→逐头切分→逐头 softmax(QKᵀ/√d_h)V→输出投影的四拍，与 llama.py forward 五行逐行同构（split([q_size,kv_size,kv_size]) 的 kv_size 出现两次=『K 一份 V 一份』；scaling=head_dim**-0.5=式7 的 √d_h）。worked example：T=3 token、H=2 头、d=4 的张量形状走一遍（投影 (3,8)→view (3,2,4)→逐头分数 (2,3,3)）；与 ch20 站 6 kernel 形状对上。图素材：MHA 接线图（GQA Fig.2 左面板重绘）。

mechanisms.name: MQA：H 个 KV 头减到 1——cache/带宽降 H 倍、容量同步被砍

sections: §2.2（reducing … by a factor of H 句）

mechanisms.note: MQA=Shazeer 2019（GQA 论文谱系引用）——多 query 头共享单个 K/V 头；『decoder inference 的 memory bandwidth 瓶颈在加载 K/V』是两代论文共同的开场。worked example：H=32 头 MHA→MQA：每 token 元素 2·32·d→2·d（缩 32 倍），同时 K/V 表达容量也缩 32 倍——『bandwidth 和 capacity 双砍』。代码对照：QKVParallelLinear 里 total_num_kv_heads=1 即 num_kv_head_replicas=tp_size（每 rank 复制同一份）。

mechanisms.name: GQA-g 插值：每组共享一份 K/V + 组数取舍 + uptraining 配方
mechanisms.note: GQA-1=MQA、GQA-H=MHA 的插值定义；GQA 论文的三条工程贡献都要点到：(a) mean-pool 转换+α=0.05 uptraining（MHA checkpoint 不必重训）；(b) 组数 trade-off（1→8 组温和、近 MHA 递增——Fig.6，LLaMA-2/3 选 8 的出处）；(c) 大模型 KV cache 随模型维线性、FLOPs 随平方——GQA 让带宽/容量随规模同比缩。worked example：Llama-3-70B 64 Q 头/8 KV 头→每组 8 个 query 头共享 1 份 K/V、cache=MHA 的 1/8；代码对照 kv_size=num_kv_heads×head_dim 与 output_sizes k/v 段。图素材：GQA Fig.2（key_figures 已登记）。

mechanisms.name: MLA 低秩联合压缩：式(9)-(11)、只缓存 c^KV
mechanisms.note: 『不砍头、改降维』：W^DKV 把 K/V 联合压进 d_c=512 维潜向量（≪d_h·n_h=16384），W^UK/W^UV 逐头上投影恢复；推理只缓存 c^KV。与 GQA 的本质差异要正面讲：GQA 复制现成向量（离散的头选择）、MLA 共享生成基底（连续的低秩子空间）——所以 MLA 能『等效 2.25 组』却不受 D.1 那条质量罚。worked example：512 维 c^KV → 上投影出 128 头×128 维 k 与 v——每个头是同一潜向量的不同线性投影；代码对照 fused_qkv_a_proj 输出宽 [1536, 512+64] 与 kv_b_proj 输出宽 heads×(128+128)。图素材：V2 Fig.3 MLA 面板（key_figures 已登记）。

mechanisms.name: query 侧低秩：式(12)-(13) c^Q 与 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 的不压分支
mechanisms.note: c^Q∈R^{d_c'}（1536）压的是训练期激活内存、不压 cache（query 不缓存）；W^QR 也从 c^Q 出（式14）——query 路径整条低秩。DeepSeek-V2-Lite 干脆不压（16 头/27 层/不压 query，App B.1），代码对应 q_lora_rank=None 的退化分支：kv_a_proj_with_mqa + 直接 q_proj——同一份代码吃两种配置，证明 query 压缩是独立旋钮。worked example：形状账 q 路径 H×(128+64)=24576 直接投 vs 1536 潜再投两段。

embed_excerpts.what: 标准 MHA 基线全数学：h_t 经 W^Q/W^K/W^V 三投影（式1-3）→ 切 n_h 头（式4-6，三条独立编号的逐头切分等式）→ 逐头 softmax(q^T k/√d_h)·v（式7）→ W^O 拼回（式8）；尾句给出本章全部变体的靶子——MHA 推理需缓存 2·n_h·d_h·l 个元素/token，『限制最大 batch 与序列长度的瓶颈』。
embed_excerpts.code:
The standard MHA mechanism is formulated as follows: first, the hidden state of each token is projected onto query, key, and value respectively through three matrices:

\[\mathbf{q}_{t} = W^{Q}\mathbf{h}_{t} \tag{1}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t} = W^{K}\mathbf{h}_{t} \tag{2}\]

\[\mathbf{v}_{t} = W^{V}\mathbf{h}_{t} \tag{3}\]

where \(\mathbf{h}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}\) denotes the hidden state of the t-th token; \(W^{Q},W^{K}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}n_{h}\times d}\) are the projection matrices for queries and keys; and \(W^{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}n_{h}\times d}\) is the projection matrix for values. \(n_{h}\) and \(d_{h}\) respectively denote the number of attention heads and the dimension per attention head. Then, the queries, keys, and values will be split into \(n_{h}\) heads to compute the attention score respectively:

\[[\mathbf{q}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{q}_{t,n_{h}}]=\mathbf{q}_{t}, \tag{4}\]

\[[\mathbf{k}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{k}_{t,n_{h}}]=\mathbf{k}_{t}, \tag{5}\]

\[[\mathbf{v}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{v}_{t,n_{h}}]=\mathbf{v}_{t}, \tag{6}\]

\[\mathbf{o}_{t,i}=\sum_{j=1}^{t}\operatorname{Softmax}_{j}\left(\frac{\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{T}\mathbf{k}_{j,i}}{\sqrt{d_{h}}}\right)\mathbf{v}_{j,i}, \tag{7}\]

\[\mathbf{u}_{t}=W^{O}[\mathbf{o}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{o}_{t,n_{h}}], \tag{8}\]

where \(\mathbf{q}_{t,i},\mathbf{k}_{t,i},\mathbf{v}_{t,i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}}\) denote the query, key, and value of the i-th attention head, respectively; \(W^{O}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d_{h}n_{h}}\) denotes the output projection matrix. During inference, all keys and values need to be cached to accelerate inference, so MHA needs to cache \(2n_{h}d_{h}l\) elements for each token. In model deployment, this heavy KV cache is a large bottleneck that limits the maximum batch size and sequence length.

embed_excerpts.what: 分组压缩的一手定义：query 头分 G 组、每组共享单个 K/V 头；GQA-1=MQA、GQA-H=MHA；MHA→MQA 把 H 个 KV 头减到 1 个——KV cache 与加载量降 H 倍；大模型头数随规模涨，MQA 对带宽与容量都是更激进的砍法，GQA 保持同比缩减。Fig.2 是 MHA/MQA/GQA 三架构对照的领域标准图（key_figures 已登记）。
embed_excerpts.code:
![Figure 2: Overview of grouped-query method. Multi-head attention has H query, key, and value heads. Multi-query attention shares single key and value heads across all query heads. Grouped-query attention instead shares single key and value heads for each *group* of query heads, interpolating between multi-head and multi-query attention.](https://arxiv.org/extracted/5314337/images/gmq_architecture.png)

Grouped-query attention divides query heads into G _groups_, each of which shares a single key head and value head. GQA-g refers to grouped-query with G groups. GQA-1, with a single group and therefore single key and value head, is equivalent to MQA, while GQA-h, with groups equal to number of heads, is equivalent to MHA. Figure 2 shows a comparison of grouped-query attention and multi-head/multi-query attention. When converting a multi-head checkpoint to a GQA checkpoint, we construct each group key and value head by mean-pooling all the original heads within that group.

An intermediate number of groups leads to an interpolated model that is higher quality than MQA but faster than MHA, and, as we will show, represents a favorable trade-off. Going from MHA to MQA reduces H key and value heads to a single key and value head, reducing the size of the key-value cache and therefore amount of data that needs to be loaded by a factor of H. However, larger models generally scale the number of heads, such that multi-query attention represents a more aggressive cut in both memory bandwidth and capacity. GQA lets us keep the same proportional decrease in bandwidth and capacity as model size increases.

Moreover, larger models suffer relatively less from memory bandwidth overhead from attention, as the KV-cache scales with model dimension while model FLOPs and parameters scale with the square of model dimension. Finally, standard sharding for large models replicates the single key and value head by the number of model partitions (Pope et al., 2022); GQA removes the waste from such partitioning. Therefore, we expect GQA to present a particularly good trade-off for larger models.

embed_excerpts.code:
Generating a multi-query model from a multi-head model takes place in two steps: first, converting the checkpoint, and second, additional pre-training to allow the model to adapt to its new structure. Figure 1 shows the process for converting a multi-head checkpoint into a multi-query checkpoint. The projection matrices for key and value heads are mean pooled into single projection matrices, which we find works better than selecting a single key and value head or randomly initializing new key and value heads from scratch.

![Figure 1: Overview of conversion from multi-head to multi-query attention. Key and value projection matrices from all heads are mean pooled into a single head.](https://arxiv.org/extracted/5314337/images/recycling.png)

The converted checkpoint is then pre-trained for a small proportion α of its original training steps on the same pre-training recipe.

Figure 6 demonstrates the effect of the number of GQA groups on inference speed. For larger models the memory bandwidth overhead from the KV cache is less constraining (Shazeer, 2019), while the reduction in key-value size is sharper due to the increased number of heads. As a result, increasing the number of groups from MQA only results in modest slowdowns initially, with increasing cost as we move closer to MHA. We selected 8 groups as a favorable middle ground.

Figure 6: Time per sample for GQA-XXL as a function of the number of GQA groups with input length 2048 and output length 512. Going from 1 (MQA) to 8 groups adds modest inference overhead, with increasing cost to adding more groups.

embed_excerpts.lines: Eq.(9)-(13) 低秩联合压缩 + 吸收论断 (paper-mla.md:L52-L68)
embed_excerpts.what: MLA 核心：c^KV=W^DKV·h_t（式9）压进 d_c 维潜向量，k^C/v^C 由 W^UK/W^UV 上投影恢复（式10-11）；推理只缓存 c^KV（d_c·l 个元素）；关键论断——W^UK 可吸进 W^Q、W^UV 可吸进 W^O，『甚至不需要把 K/V 算出来』。query 侧同构低秩（式12-13，d_c'，压训练激活不压 cache）。
embed_excerpts.code:
The core of MLA is the low-rank joint compression for keys and values to reduce KV cache:

\[\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}=W^{DKV}\mathbf{h}_{t}, \tag{9}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t}^{C}=W^{UK}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}, \tag{10}\]

\[\mathbf{v}_{t}^{C}=W^{UV}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}, \tag{11}\]

where \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{c}}\) is the compressed latent vector for keys and values; \(d_{c}(\ll d_{h}n_{h})\) denotes the KV compression dimension; \(W^{DKV}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{c}\times d}\) is the down-projection matrix; and \(W^{UK},W^{UV}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}n_{h}\times d_{c}}\) are the up-projection matrices for keys and values, respectively. During inference, MLA only needs to cache \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\), so its KV cache has only \(d_{c}l\) elements, where \(l\) denotes the number of layers. In addition, during inference, since \(W^{UK}\) can be absorbed into \(W^{Q}\), and \(W^{UV}\) can be absorbed into \(W^{O}\), we even do not need to compute keys and values out for attention. Figure 3 intuitively illustrates how the KV joint compression in MLA reduces the KV cache.

Moreover, in order to reduce the activation memory during training, we also perform low-rank compression for the queries, even if it cannot reduce the KV cache:

\[\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}=W^{DQ}\mathbf{h}_{t}, \tag{12}\]

\[\mathbf{q}_{t}^{C}=W^{UQ}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}, \tag{13}\]

where \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{c}^{\prime}}\) is the compressed latent vector for queries; \(d_{c}^{\prime}(\ll d_{h}n_{h})\) denotes the query compression dimension; \(W^{DQ}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{c}^{\prime}\times d}\) is the down-projection matrix for queries; and \(W^{UQ}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}n_{h}\times d_{c}^{\prime}}\) is the up-projection matrix for queries.

### 2.1.3 Decoupled Rotary Position Embedding

Following DeepSeek 67B, we intend to use the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) for DeepSeek-V2. However, RoPE is incompatible with low-rank KV compression. To be specific, RoPE is position-sensitive for both keys and queries. If we apply RoPE for the keys \(\mathbf{k}_{t}^{C}\), \(W^{UK}\) in Equation 10 will be coupled with a position-sensitive RoPE matrix. In this way, \(W^{UK}\) cannot be absorbed into \(W^{Q}\) any more during inference, since a RoPE matrix related to the currently generating token will lie between \(W^{Q}\) and \(W^{UK}\) and matrix multiplication does not obey a commutative law. As a result, we must recompute the keys for all the prefix tokens during inference, which will significantly hinder the inference efficiency.

As a solution, we propose the decoupled RoPE strategy that uses additional multi-head queries \(\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{R}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}^{R}}\) and a shared key \(\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}^{R}}\) to carry RoPE, where \(d_{h}^{R}\) denotes the per-head dimension of the decoupled queries and key. Equipped with the decoupled RoPE strategy, MLA performs the following computation:

\[[\mathbf{q}_{t,1}^{R};\ldots;\mathbf{q}_{t,n_{h}}^{R}]=\mathbf{q}_{t}^{R}=\operatorname{RoPE}(W^{QR}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}), \tag{14}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}=\operatorname{RoPE}(W^{KR}\mathbf{h}_{t}), \tag{15}\]

\[\mathbf{q}_{t,i}=[\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{C};\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{R}], \tag{16}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t,i}=[\mathbf{k}_{t,i}^{C};\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}], \tag{17}\]

\[\mathbf{o}_{t,i}=\sum_{j=1}^{t}\operatorname{Softmax}_{j}\left(\frac{\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{T}\mathbf{k}_{j,i}}{\sqrt{d_{h}+d_{h}^{R}}}\right)\mathbf{v}_{j,i}^{C}, \tag{18}\]

\[\mathbf{u}_{t}=W^{O}[\mathbf{o}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{o}_{t,n_{h}}], \tag{19}\]

where \(W^{QR}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}^{R}n_{h}\times d_{c}^{\prime}}\) and \(W^{KR}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}^{R}\times d}\) are matrices to produce the decoupled queries and key, respectively; \(\operatorname{RoPE}(\cdot)\) denotes the operation that applies RoPE matrices; and \([\cdot;\cdot]\) denotes the concatenation operation. During inference, the decoupled key should also be cached. Therefore, DeepSeek-V2 requires a total KV cache containing \((d_{c}+d_{h}^{R})l\) elements.

### 2.1.4 Comparison of Key-Value Cache

We demonstrate a comparison of the KV cache per token among different attention mechanisms in Table 1. MLA requires only a small amount of KV cache, equal to GQA with only 2.25 groups, but can achieve stronger performance than MHA.

Table 1: Comparison of the KV cache per token among different attention mechanisms. \(n_{h}\) denotes the number of attention heads, \(d_{h}\) denotes the dimension per attention head, \(l\) denotes the number of layers, \(n_{g}\) denotes the number of groups in GQA, and \(d_{c}\) and \(d_{h}^{R}\) denote the KV compression dimension and the per-head dimension of the decoupled queries and key in MLA, respectively. The amount of KV cache is measured by the number of elements, regardless of the storage precision. For DeepSeek-V2, \(d_{c}\) is set to \(4d_{h}\) and \(d_{h}^{R}\) is set to \(d_{h}/2\). So, its KV cache is equal to GQA with only 2.25 groups, but its performance is stronger than MHA.

| Attention | KV Cache (per token) |
|---|---|
| MHA | \(2n_{h}d_{h}l\) |
| MQA | \(2d_{h}l\) |
| GQA | \(2n_{g}d_{h}l\) |
| MLA | \((d_{c}+d_{h}^{R})l\) |

## MLA 超参数(摘自 §3.1.2 Model Hyper-Parameters)

DeepSeek-V2 in total contains 236B parameters, of which 21B are activated for each token. We set the number of Transformer layers to 60 and the hidden dimension to 5120. In MLA, we set the number of attention heads \(n_{h}\) to 128 and the per-head dimension \(d_{h}\) to 128. The KV compression dimension \(d_{c}\) is set to 512, and the query compression dimension \(d_{c}^{\prime}\) is set to 1536. For the decoupled queries and key, we set the per-head dimension \(d_{h}^{R}\) to 64.

Due to the co-impact of the MoE and MLA architectures, the output scale of each layer exhibits a greater magnitude than that of a standard Transformer. Considering the potential convergence risk imposed by large propagation scale, in practice, we employ additional RMS Norm layers after the compressed latent vectors, and multiply additional scaling factors at the width bottlenecks (i.e., the compressed latent vectors and the intermediate hidden states of routed experts) to ensure stable training.

## Appendix C Full Formulas of MLA

In order to demonstrate the complete computation process of MLA, we provide its full formulas in the following:

\[\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}=W^{DQ}\mathbf{h}_{t}, \tag{37}\]

\[\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}=W^{DKV}\mathbf{h}_{t}, \tag{38}\]

\[[\mathbf{q}_{t,1}^{R};\ldots;\mathbf{q}_{t,n_{h}}^{R}]=\mathbf{q}_{t}^{R}=\operatorname{RoPE}(W^{QR}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}), \tag{39}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}=\operatorname{RoPE}(W^{KR}\mathbf{h}_{t}), \tag{40}\]

\[\boxed{\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}},\quad\boxed{\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}} \tag{41}\]

\[\mathbf{q}_{t}^{C}=W^{UQ}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}, \tag{42}\]

\[[\mathbf{k}_{t,1}^{C};\ldots;\mathbf{k}_{t,n_{h}}^{C}]=\mathbf{k}_{t}^{C}=W^{UK}\boxed{\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}}, \tag{43}\]

\[[\mathbf{v}_{t,1}^{C};\ldots;\mathbf{v}_{t,n_{h}}^{C}]=\mathbf{v}_{t}^{C}=W^{UV}\boxed{\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}}, \tag{44}\]

\[\mathbf{q}_{t,i}=[\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{C};\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{R}], \tag{45}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t,i}=[\mathbf{k}_{t,i}^{C};\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}], \tag{46}\]

\[\mathbf{o}_{t,i}=\sum_{j=1}^{t}\operatorname{Softmax}_{j}\left(\frac{\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{T}\mathbf{k}_{j,i}}{\sqrt{d_{h}+d_{h}^{R}}}\right)\mathbf{v}_{j,i}^{C},\quad \mathbf{u}_{t}=W^{O}[\mathbf{o}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{o}_{t,n_{h}}] \tag{47}\]

[注:式 (41) 在原文中不是一个独立等式,而是把 (38)/(40) 的两个「需缓存向量」\(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\) 与 \(\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}\) 用蓝框单独标出(原文 boxed in blue);此处以 boxed 保留该语义。(43)/(44) 中的 boxed 表示 k/v 上投影的输入即被缓存的 \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\)。]

During inference, the naive formula needs to recover \(\mathbf{k}_{t}^{C}\) and \(\mathbf{v}_{t}^{C}\) from \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\) for attention. Fortunately, due to the associative law of matrix multiplication, we can absorb \(W^{UK}\) into \(W^{UQ}\), and \(W^{UV}\) into \(W^{O}\). Since this optimization is related to only model parameters, it can be completed offline at once. Through this optimization, we avoid the computational overhead for recomputing \(\mathbf{k}_{t}^{C}\) and \(\mathbf{v}_{t}^{C}\) during inference.

V3 报告将 MLA 压缩为一节重述,数学与 V2 完全一致(仅记号排布略异),并把「需要缓存什么」用蓝框直接写进公式——这一版重述对「KV cache 装的是什么」比 V2 原文更醒目:

The core of MLA is the low-rank joint compression for attention keys and values to reduce Key-Value (KV) cache during inference:

\[\boxed{\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}=W^{DKV}\mathbf{h}_{t}} \tag{V3-1}\]

\[[\mathbf{k}_{t,1}^{C};\ldots;\mathbf{k}_{t,n_{h}}^{C}]=\mathbf{k}_{t}^{C}=W^{UK}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV} \tag{V3-2}\]

\[\boxed{\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}=\operatorname{RoPE}(W^{KR}\mathbf{h}_{t})} \tag{V3-3}\]

\[\mathbf{k}_{t,i}=[\mathbf{k}_{t,i}^{C};\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}] \tag{V3-4}\]

\[[\mathbf{v}_{t,1}^{C};\ldots;\mathbf{v}_{t,n_{h}}^{C}]=\mathbf{v}_{t}^{C}=W^{UV}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV} \tag{V3-5}\]

\[\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}=W^{DQ}\mathbf{h}_{t} \tag{V3-6}\]

\[[\mathbf{q}_{t,1}^{C};\ldots;\mathbf{q}_{t,n_{h}}^{C}]=\mathbf{q}_{t}^{C}=W^{UQ}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q} \tag{V3-7}\]

\[[\mathbf{q}_{t,1}^{R};\ldots;\mathbf{q}_{t,n_{h}}^{R}]=\mathbf{q}_{t}^{R}=\operatorname{RoPE}(W^{QR}\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}) \tag{V3-8}\]

\[\mathbf{q}_{t,i}=[\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{C};\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{R}] \tag{V3-9}\]

\[\mathbf{o}_{t,i}=\sum_{j=1}^{t}\operatorname{Softmax}_{j}\left(\frac{\mathbf{q}_{t,i}^{T}\mathbf{k}_{j,i}}{\sqrt{d_{h}+d_{h}^{R}}}\right)\mathbf{v}_{j,i}^{C}, \tag{V3-10}\]

\[\mathbf{u}_{t}=W^{O}[\mathbf{o}_{t,1};\ldots;\mathbf{o}_{t,n_{h}}] \tag{V3-11}\]

where \(\mathbf{h}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}\) denotes the input hidden state of the t-th token, \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\) and \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{Q}\) respectively denote the compressed latent vectors for keys-values and queries, \(\operatorname{RoPE}(\cdot)\) denotes the application of RoPE matrices, and \(W^{(\cdot)}\) are projection matrices. Note that for MLA, only the blue-boxed vectors (i.e., \(\mathbf{c}_{t}^{KV}\) and \(\mathbf{k}_{t}^{R}\)) need to be cached during generation, which results in significantly reduced KV cache while maintaining performance comparable to standard Multi-Head Attention (MHA).

class QKVParallelLinear(ColumnParallelLinear):
    """Linear layers for the attention's QKV transformation.

    Linear layers for the linear transformation of the query, key, and value
    vectors in the attention layer. The weight matrix is concatenated along
    the output dimension. The layer is parallelized along the head dimension.
    When the number of key/value heads is smaller than the number of query
    heads (e.g., multi-query/grouped-query attention), the key/value head may
    be replicated while the query heads are partitioned.

    Args:
        hidden_size: input hidden state size of the transformer.
        head_size: size of each attention head.
        total_num_heads: total number of attention query heads.
        total_num_kv_heads: total number of attention key/value heads. If
                            None, assume total_num_kv_heads = total_num_heads.
        bias: If true, add bias.
        skip_bias_add: This was added to enable performance optimizations where
                       bias can be fused with other element-wise operations. we
                       skip adding bias but instead return it.
        params_dtype: Data type for the parameters.
        quant_config: Quantization configure.
        prefix: The name of the layer in the state dict, including all parents
                        (e.g. model.layers.0.qkv_proj)
        return_bias: If true, return bias together with outputs in forward pass.
        disable_tp: If true, weights matrix won't be sharded through tp rank.
    """

def forward(
        self,
        positions: torch.Tensor,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        llama_4_scaling: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        q_c = None
        kv_lora = None

        if self.q_lora_rank is not None:
            assert self.fused_qkv_a_proj is not None, (
                "fused_qkv_a_proj is required when q_lora_rank is not None"
            )
            assert self.q_a_layernorm is not None, (
                "q_a_layernorm is required when q_lora_rank is not None"
            )
            assert self.q_b_proj is not None, (
                "q_b_proj is required when q_lora_rank is not None"
            )

            qkv_lora = self.fused_qkv_a_proj(hidden_states)[0]
            q_c, kv_lora = qkv_lora.split(
                [self.q_lora_rank, self.kv_lora_rank + self.qk_rope_head_dim],
                dim=-1,
            )
            q_c = self.q_a_layernorm(q_c)
            q_proj_layer = self.q_b_proj
            q_proj_input = q_c
        else:
            assert self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa is not None, (
                "kv_a_proj_with_mqa is required when q_lora_rank is None"
            )
            assert self.q_proj is not None, (
                "q_proj is required when q_lora_rank is None"
            )
            kv_lora = self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa(hidden_states)[0]
            q_proj_layer = self.q_proj
            q_proj_input = hidden_states

        kv_c, k_pe = kv_lora.split([self.kv_lora_rank, self.qk_rope_head_dim], dim=-1)
        kv_c_normed = self.kv_a_layernorm(kv_c)
        # Add head dim of 1 to k_pe
        k_pe = k_pe.unsqueeze(1)

        q = q_proj_layer(q_proj_input)[0]
        heads = self.num_heads
        if self.dcp_q_replicate:
            heads *= q_proj_layer.group_size
        q = q.view(-1, heads, self.qk_head_dim)

        if self.rotary_emb is not None:
            q[..., self.qk_nope_head_dim :], k_pe = self.rotary_emb(
                positions, q[..., self.qk_nope_head_dim :], k_pe
            )

        if self.indexer and self.is_sparse and not self.skip_topk:
            self.indexer(hidden_states, q_c, positions, self.indexer_rope_emb)

        if llama_4_scaling is not None:
            q *= llama_4_scaling

        q_dcp_replicated = None
        if self.dcp_q_replicate:
            q_dcp_replicated, q = q, q_proj_layer._local_view(q)

        attn_out = self.mla_attn(
            q,
            kv_c_normed,
            k_pe,
            output_shape=(hidden_states.shape[0], self.num_heads * self.v_head_dim),
            q_dcp_replicated=q_dcp_replicated,
        )

        if self.g_proj is not None:
            attn_out = attn_out * self.g_proj(hidden_states)[0].sigmoid()

        return self.o_proj(attn_out)[0]

embed_excerpts.code:
MLA has two possible ways of computing, a data-movement friendly approach and a
compute friendly approach. We generally want to use the compute friendly
approach for "prefill" (i.e. the ratio Sq / Skv is relatively large, often near
1) and the data-movement friendly approach for "decode" (i.e. the ratio
Sq / Skv is small, often near 0).

NOTE what we deem small and large is currently determined by if it is labelled
prefill or decode by the scheduler, but this is something we should probably
tune.

Main reference: DeepseekV2 paper, and FlashInfer Implementation
(https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434 and https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/551).

Deepseek's MLA attention works the following way:
* Use a single latent vector to represent the per-token entry of the KV cache.
* For decode (i.e. the memory friendly approach) the attention "simulates" a
multi-head attention, while the compute is similar to multi-query attention.

Below is an example of both paths assuming batch size = 1

## More Extent Definitions:

C           Context length, `Skv - Sq`
H           hidden size
N           number of attention heads
Lq          latent dimension for Q              1536 in DSV3
Lkv         latent dimension for K/V            512 in DSV3
P           nope dimension, no rope.            128 in DSV3
R           rope dimension, goes through rope.  64 in DSV3
V           V head dim.                         128 in DSV3

## Vector/Matrix Definitions

h_t         hidden states (input to attention)  shape [Sq, H]
q_c         latent/compressed Q                 shape [Sq, Lq]
q_nope      uncompressed Q (no-rope)            shape [Sq, N, P]
q_pe        uncompressed Q (rope)               shape [Sq, N, R]
kv_c        latent/compressed KV                shape [Skv, Lkv]
k_pe        decoupled k position embeddings     shape [Skv, R]
new_kv_c    new kv_c from current iter          shape [Sq, Lkv]
new_k_pe    new k_pe from current iter          shape [Sq, R]
cache_kv_c  cached k_c from previous iters      shape [C, Lkv]
cache_k_pe  cached k_pe from previous iters     shape [C, R]
W_DQ        project h_t to q_c                  shape [H, Lq]
W_UQ        project q_c to q_nope               shape [Lq, N * P]
W_QR        project q_c to q_pe                 shape [Lq, N * R]
W_DKV       project h_t to kv_c                 shape [H, Lkv]
W_UK        project kv_c to k_nope              shape [Lkv, N, P]
W_KR        project h_t to k_pe                 shape [H, R]
W_UV        project kv_c to v                   shape [Lkv, N, V]
W_O         project v to h_t                    shape [N * V, H]
